promptEs: En Re♭ mayor, ¿cómo se cifra el dominante secundario que resuelve en ii?
promptEn: In D♭ major, how is the secondary dominant that resolves to ii labelled?
explanationEs: En Re♭ mayor, el dominante de ii es Si♭7 y se cifra V/ii. Resuelve en Mi♭m (ii): su tercera es la sensible de Mi♭m y sube un semitono.
explanationEn: In D♭ major, the dominant of ii is B♭7 and it is labelled V/ii. It resolves to E♭m (ii): its third is the leading tone of E♭m and rises a semitone.
